## Professional Repository Baseline

This PR establishes a professional repository baseline for the Employee Management System, transforming it into a production-ready HR domain application.

### 📋 Changes Included

#### Documentation
- ✅ Comprehensive bilingual README.md (PT-BR/EN) with C4 architecture diagram
- ✅ MIT License
- ✅ Code of Conduct (Contributor Covenant 2.1)
- ✅ Contributing guidelines
- ✅ Security policy and vulnerability reporting
- ✅ Support documentation
- ✅ Comprehensive changelog
- ✅ Architecture documentation with detailed system design
- ✅ Architecture Decision Records (ADR) framework

#### Configuration Files
- ✅ Enhanced .gitignore for Java + Node.js projects
- ✅ .editorconfig for consistent code formatting
- ✅ .gitattributes for proper file handling
- ✅ CODEOWNERS for automated review assignments

#### GitHub Integration
- ✅ Issue templates for bugs, features, and questions
- ✅ Pull request template
- ✅ CI/CD workflows for Java 17
- ✅ CodeQL security analysis
- ✅ Dependabot configuration for dependency updates
- ✅ Release drafter for automated release notes

#### Technical Improvements
- ✅ Updated Java version from 11 to 17
- ✅ Fixed test package structure alignment
- ✅ Improved build configuration
- ✅ Enhanced project organization

### 🏗️ Architecture Highlights

The system follows a clean layered architecture:

```
User (HR Manager) → Frontend Layer → API Layer → Service Layer → Repository Layer → Data Layer
```

- ✅ All tests pass
